name: errand-joy-bot
description: Give Claude Code a capped, ledgered way to ask for purchases. Agents request; a self-hosted gate enforces tiers, caps and a weekly joy budget; only the owner approves, from a private one-tap link.

gate_url.title: Gate URL
gate_url.description: Where your purchase gate listens. It binds to loopback only, so use http://127.0.0.1:47400 on the gate host. From another machine, forward a local port over SSH (ssh -L 47400:127.0.0.1:47400 gatehost); never publish the gate.

agent_token.title: Gate agent token (request-only)
agent_token.description: GATE_AGENT_TOKEN from the gate's .env. It can only submit requests and read status. Never enter the admin token or any vendor key here.

joy_todo_path.title: Joy: owner's to-do list (optional)
joy_todo_path.description: A text or markdown file the quiet-joy routine may read to find small frictions worth fixing.

joy_notes_dir.title: Joy: owner's notes folder (optional)
joy_notes_dir.description: A folder of notes the quiet-joy routine may skim for recent interests and wishes.

joy_owned_items_path.title: Joy: owned-items list (optional)
joy_owned_items_path.description: A file listing things the owner already has, so joy never buys duplicates.

joy_household_ok.title: Joy: allow shared household spaces
joy_household_ok.description: Off by default: joy picks are for the owner's own use and space only. Turn on to allow small things for shared spaces (still never for another person's own space).
